{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:13.219

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:08.220

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:22.220
    | text      = There was Lost Lake there and I tried to go mess around with the lake a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:28.220
    | text      = But it seemed like all the roads, everything that was close to the lake, ended up being on someone else's property.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:38.220
    | text      = So I would have to have crossed people's yards and stuff to get to the lake.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:43.220
    | text      = And I didn't want to do that. So I just kind of left Lost Nation alone.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:48.220
    | text      = Yeah. Well, I mean, presumably if you ventured too far in there, you would never be able to return.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It's a risk I'm willing to take. I mean, if I find the Atlanteans, then it's all worth it.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:21.220
    | text      = It's a little bit too far, but I decide, fuck it, I'm going to go see both Lost Nations in a day.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I would bet you see more than one.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:30.220

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:39.220

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = But not a whole lot. Kind of a sleepy town. There was a pub there and a main drag, just one street.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:55.220

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:07.220
    | text      = I think that it might be the Lost City of Amazons. Maybe. Maybe the Lost Nation of wherever fucking Wonder Woman came from.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:23.220

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:49.220

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:30.220
    | text      = And then she makes some art based on that and she's so good and so talented that why would I want it anywhere else?

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:37.220

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:44.220

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:54.220
    | text      = With bartenders, when I was alone there were bartenders. I would go to those bars regularly and eventually the bartenders would be like, man, you're a good dude.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.220

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I think they were fucking with me because I tipped well.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:45.220

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = The establishment doesn't carry any kind of consistent position anymore. It's all just, it kind of just means well funded or not so desperate for money that you would sell a low IQ hat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:44.220
    | text      = Like it doesn't mean anything like it felt like it used to. Like the man doesn't, everyone's selling out. Everyone, like there's no shame in selling out anymore. It's not the world that we grew up in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:56.220
    | text      = Who's owned by the right billionaire? Like there's probably a billionaire that doesn't a billionaire own The Onion and a billionaire owns CNN and a billionaire owns all that stuff. That's the establishment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:06.220
    | text      = If not owns, you know, has financial ties to, you know, or whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:12.220
    | text      = The thing about it, right, is if you can call somebody to change their bullshit, then those people already operate under the idea that pleasing you involves changing their bullshit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:26.220
    | text      = So before you have to call and say anything, you have changed your bullshit. That's the way that that kind of functions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:33.220
    | text      = Yeah, there's a prior constraint that comes along with, or at least the image of that, the feel of that. And that's not to say that The Onion isn't independent. I have no reason to believe that they don't have as much independence as you can have.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:48.220
    | text      = But they, you know, it would be silly to imagine that they're not like connected to very rich people with strong interests in things too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:58.220
    | text      = So I don't know, but like so's Info Wars. So like, are they the establishment too?

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:04.220
    | text      = Yeah, basically. I think we're the only people who are not the establishment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:10.220
    | text      = I think that they're not, but only because they're such dorks. Like, I think because they do things like sell low IQ hats, the establishment doesn't want them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:23.220
    | text      = But Alex could still probably call some rich people. They just wouldn't give him money. They'd answer, but they wouldn't give him money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:30.220
    | text      = Yeah. Yeah. I mean, you know, the reason that selling out has to happen now is because it feels like the only way to get an established audience is by joining the establishment. Otherwise you'll be like us and you'll kind of be really cool, but on the edge, on the outside.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:47.220
    | text      = I don't know if I'm that cool, but I did find two lost nations in a day, which has to be a record. I found them.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:54.220

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:56.220
    | text      = Nope. So in this next clip, Harrison, I would say, accuses Ben Collins, the CEO of The Onion of a crime that could almost certainly sue Harrison.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:08.220
    | text      = Cool. He's like Ben Collins, who's the CEO of The Onion is the one telling everybody that he purchased us. But again, it just, they can lie. They can misrepresent us. They can say that they're us. They can claim that they own us. Nothing happens to them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:23.220
    | text      = They can rig a federal bankruptcy proceeding and just nothing happens to them. They just get away with it. It really is crazy. And like that to me is the only like disheartening thing about this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:37.220
    | text      = I don't really care about The Onion. I mean, for the record, I went ahead and asked Garak today, Infowars has two times the traffic of The Onion. At least, like on a monthly basis.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:50.220
    | text      = And this is with The Onion having poured millions and millions of dollars trying desperately to regain the cultural cachet that they have lost over the last several decades.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:00.220
    | text      = I think Ben could sue Harrison for that. Like Ben's almost certainly a public figure. So the defamation threshold is high, but Harrison's accusing him of a crime. And he absolutely knows that accusation is false as he's saying it. There's no way that this isn't defamatory.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:18.220
    | text      = But more importantly, I'm glad that Harrison's robot friend reassured him that he was more popular than The Onion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:25.220
    | text      = It's interesting that he uses the metric of internet traffic because the whole push of The New Onion has been to bring back the print version of the paper. It's not like they've abandoned the internet or stopped trying to get traffic, but their focus has been on the paper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:39.220
    | text      = And by anyone's count, that's been quite a big success. That they've done a good job of bringing back the physical copy of the paper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:31:49.220
    | text      = Which makes me want to ask Harrison if he wants to go back to Grok and ask how the circulation of Info Wars magazine is going, or if that hasn't existed in like 12 years because no one wanted it. But I have it. I got copies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:03.220
    | text      = Yes you do. No doubt.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Antiques. No, not quite. 12 years as an antique, but we're getting there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:11.220
    | text      = Yeah, I mean, I hate to say this, but as far as advertisements for not suing for defamation goes, I think where we are is about as good as it gets.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:24.220
    | text      = Right. Well, I agree, and I think that it wouldn't be worth his time to sue. I only bring it up as like, you know, part and parcel of what Harrison is doing is like, they get away with so much and we can't get away with anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:39.220
    | text      = And just to highlight, like, no, you engage in casual defamation that no one even cares about because they know it would be too much trouble to deal with your dumbasses who don't cooperate in courts. So like, you get away with everything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:54.220
    | text      = Yeah. I mean, it must be said that that strategy is absolutely correct. And that the legal system is fucked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:05.220
    | text      = I only want to change the word correct to useful.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:10.220
    | text      = There we go. Much better.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:54.219
    | text      = After the explosion at this hospital in Gaza, the New York Times published a headline saying, quote, Israeli strikes kill hundreds in hospital, Palestinians say.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:14.219

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:27.219
